title: The future of coding with AI pair programming

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your code had a super-smart co-pilot?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI pair programming is already changing how developers work.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s an AI that writes code with you in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: GitHub’s Copilot can suggest entire functions as you type.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This speeds up development for startups and solo devs alike.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of coding isn’t just smarter — it’s faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Try it yourself — what would you build with an AI partner?
